applicability: Reusing an allocated curator-ingest entry key after scope has been recorded.
conditions: The semantic scope participates in the existing content digest.
Changed scope must use a successor entry key with the stored invariant and predecessor revision identities.
exclusions: An exact byte-equivalent retry remains a replay.
No in-place migration of historical applicability is authorized.
statement: Changing an already allocated entry's semantic scope is a content conflict requiring an explicit successor rather than an exact retry.
